edges.note: Where Sensor2Text trains a sensor-language bridge, Vivaldi avoids alignment training by distributing interpretation across agents.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: MemoPilot: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via RL over Memory
edges.note: MemoPilot fills the gap between hand-designed memory prompts and optimal memory policies with end-to-end RL training.

edges.target_label: MemoPilot: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via RL over Memory
edges.note: Where LATS searches over action trajectories, MemoPilot fixes the player LLM and trains only the memory-update policy.

edges.target_label: MemoPilot: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via RL over Memory
edges.note: MemoPilot adapts the GRPO training recipe from R1 to optimize multi-turn memory updates.

edges.target_label: LLM-as-an-Investigator: Evidence-First Reasoning for Robust Interactive Problem Diagnosis (2026)
edges.note: Where ADaPT decomposes a task into sub-plans on demand, this paper reorders the loop so evidence collection precedes commitment to a hypothesis.

edges.target_label: LLM-as-an-Investigator: Evidence-First Reasoning for Robust Interactive Problem Diagnosis (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS searches over action trees, this paper gathers evidence first to avoid the premature-hypothesis failure mode both planning and search inherit.

edges.target_label: MemToolAgent: Leveraging Memory for Tool-Using Agents Based on Environment and User Feedback (2026)
edges.note: Where ToolkenGPT makes tool selection part of next-token prediction with a static tool embedding, MemToolAgent adds an outer memory loop so the choice is also informed by past tool-call outcomes and feedback.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: Infini Memory: Maintainable Topic Documents for Long-Term LLM Agent Memory (2026)
edges.note: Where the survey maps the design space of agent memory, Infini Memory commits to one design point: topic-structured text documents revised over time instead of a flat log or a vector store.

edges.target_label: On Information Self-Locking in Reinforcement Learning for Active Reasoning of LLM Agents (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 shows reinforcement learning can produce strong single-pass reasoning, this paper studies the multi-turn information-gathering case and shows the same training can collapse exploration, then patches it with a reallocated learning signal.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: Agent Memory: Characterization and System Implications of Stateful Long-Horizon Workloads (2026)
edges.note: Where the survey organizes agent memory mechanisms by what they do, this paper measures what they cost when deployed, adding a runtime systems view to a mostly modeling-focused literature.

edges.target_label: ARLArena: A Unified Framework for Stable Agentic Reinforcement Learning (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 applied reinforcement learning to single-turn reasoning, ARLArena targets the multi-turn agent setting where rewards arrive late and credit assignment is the hard part.

edges.target_label: ARLArena: A Unified Framework for Stable Agentic Reinforcement Learning (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS improved planning through tree search at inference time, ARLArena instead changes how the policy is trained for stable updates.

edges.target_label: ARLArena: A Unified Framework for Stable Agentic Reinforcement Learning (2026)
edges.note: Where ADaPT decomposed a task into sub-tasks at inference time, ARLArena focuses on stable training infrastructure rather than a better search.

edges.target_label: AutoTrainess: Teaching Language Models to Improve Language Models Autonomously (2026)
edges.note: Where ADaPT decomposed a task on demand, AutoTrainess fixes the action space ahead of time by wrapping the training pipeline in named agent-computer interfaces, because a multi-hour training run needs reliable repeatable operations more than open-ended decomposition.

edges.target_label: AutoTrainess: Teaching Language Models to Improve Language Models Autonomously (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS searched over action trees, AutoTrainess prefers fixed, constrained operations over open-ended search so long training runs stay repeatable.

edges.source_label: ToolkenGPT: Tool Calls as Learned Tokens (Hao 2024)
edges.target_label: AutoTrainess: Teaching Language Models to Improve Language Models Autonomously (2026)
edges.note: Relative to ToolkenGPT's atomic tool calls, AutoTrainess drives a full long-horizon training workflow with preserved experiment state.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents (2026)
edges.note: Where the Memory Mechanisms Survey catalogs memory designs but does not measure them under one controlled setup, AgenticSTS turns the taxonomy into a harness where each memory layer can be ablated in isolation.

edges.target_label: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS grows and reuses search context as the task proceeds, AgenticSTS keeps the prompt bounded by rebuilding it through typed retrieval each step.

edges.target_label: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents (2026)
edges.note: Where ADaPT decomposes a task as needed and lets context grow, AgenticSTS holds the prompt at a fixed size so each memory layer can be turned off on its own.

edges.target_label: SkillOpt-Lite: Agent Self-evolution via Zeroth-Order Optimization (2026)
edges.note: Where ADaPT decomposed tasks on demand per episode, SkillOpt-Lite optimizes the reusable skills and harness themselves offline through a numerical-optimization loop.

edges.target_label: SkillOpt-Lite: Agent Self-evolution via Zeroth-Order Optimization (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS searched over action trees at inference per episode, SkillOpt-Lite treats a skill as editable code updated offline with convergence and generalization arguments from zeroth-order optimization.

edges.source_label: ToolkenGPT: Tool Use via Learned Embeddings (Hao 2024)
edges.target_label: SkillOpt-Lite: Agent Self-evolution via Zeroth-Order Optimization (2026)
edges.note: Where ToolkenGPT learned tool embeddings for tool use, SkillOpt-Lite optimizes the persistent skill library and harness that call such tools.

edges.target_label: TurnOPD: Making On-Policy Distillation Turn-Aware for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Training (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 trained reasoning with outcome-reward reinforcement learning, TurnOPD keeps on-policy training but shifts credit from token to turn for multi-turn agent distillation.

edges.target_label: TurnOPD: Making On-Policy Distillation Turn-Aware for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Training (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS spent inference-time tree search to reach good long-horizon trajectories, TurnOPD spends training-time budget to distill a teacher into the student efficiently.

edges.target_label: TurnOPD: Making On-Policy Distillation Turn-Aware for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Training (2026)
edges.note: Where PPO optimized on-policy at the token level, TurnOPD addresses its per-step credit problem with a turn-normalized loss.

edges.target_label: SIRI: Self-Internalizing RL with Intrinsic Skills for LLM Agent Training (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 used reinforcement learning to bring out long reasoning traces, SIRI uses reinforcement learning to make a policy mine and internalize its own skills, then removes those skills from the runtime so nothing extra is carried at inference.

edges.target_label: SIRI: Self-Internalizing RL with Intrinsic Skills for LLM Agent Training (2026)
edges.note: Where ADaPT relied on an external decomposition module to structure a task, SIRI has the policy summarize and validate skills from its own successful trajectories, removing the dependence on a separate generator.

edges.target_label: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 gives a single trajectory-level reward, SEED adds a dense token-level signal by re-scoring each action with and without self-written hindsight skills, so intermediate decisions receive guidance sparse outcome rewards cannot supply.

edges.target_label: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation (2026)
edges.note: Where ADaPT adds task decomposition and planning at inference time, SEED internalizes the improvement into the weights during reinforcement learning, so no external skill bank is needed at test time.

edges.target_label: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS runs explicit tree search over actions at inference, SEED converts self-written skills into a dense training signal, so decision quality improves in the weights rather than through test-time search.

edges.target_label: SearchOS-V1: Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration (2026)
edges.note: Where ADaPT decomposes a task on demand inside the reasoning trace, SearchOS moves the working state into persistent external structures shared across sub-agents.

edges.target_label: SearchOS-V1: Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS searches a tree of actions at inference time, SearchOS externalizes progress into an Evidence Graph and Failure Memory so coverage is tracked rather than re-searched.

edges.target_label: SearchOS-V1: Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration (2026)
edges.note: The Agent AI survey frames multi-agent coordination; SearchOS supplies a concrete shared-state scheme (Coverage Map plus Failure Memory) for coordinating information-seeking sub-agents.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: SearchOS-V1: Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration (2026)
edges.note: Where the memory line keeps a running store for a single agent, SearchOS makes that store shared and structured so several sub-agents coordinate coverage without repeating dead ends.

edges.target_label: Environment-free Synthetic Data Generation for API-Calling Agents (2026)
edges.note: Where ToolkenGPT assumed tools you can actually call to gather supervision, this paper removes the live environment and synthesizes the call-and-response supervision directly, because the environment, not the model, is what does not scale.

edges.target_label: Environment-free Synthetic Data Generation for API-Calling Agents (2026)
edges.note: Against ADaPT, which decomposed tasks assuming an executable setting, this work supplies training data for such planners without needing that setting to exist.

edges.target_label: Environment-free Synthetic Data Generation for API-Calling Agents (2026)
edges.note: Extends the agent-systems framing of the Durante survey toward the data bottleneck, producing tool-call trajectories without a live environment.

edges.target_label: AgentDebugX: Failure Observability, Attribution, and Recovery in LLM Agents (2026)
edges.note: Where the Agent AI Survey described what agents can do, AgentDebugX addresses what to do when an agent fails, giving measured step-level attribution and repair numbers.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: AgentDebugX: Failure Observability, Attribution, and Recovery in LLM Agents (2026)
edges.note: Where the Memory Mechanisms Survey cataloged how agents store state, AgentDebugX reuses past diagnoses as debugging memory in its Error Hub and turns a diagnosis into a rerun.

edges.target_label: AgentDebugX: Failure Observability, Attribution, and Recovery in LLM Agents (2026)
edges.note: ToolkenGPT produces tool-call steps; AgentDebugX is the diagnostic layer that attributes errors within such traces rather than adding a new agent architecture.

edges.target_label: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research (2026)
edges.note: Where the Agent AI survey framed the loop of perception, planning, and tool use, AREX adds an outer self-improvement loop that audits intermediate answers and re-plans from the partially verified state.

edges.target_label: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS searches a tree of actions and backtracks within a single pass, AREX adds an outer loop that verifies intermediate answers and re-plans, because deep research rewards constraint-checking more than searching longer.

edges.target_label: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research (2026)
edges.note: Where ToolkenGPT learned to call external tools as special tokens, AREX learns a context-update tool that compresses its own growing memory into verified evidence and open constraints without an external model.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: Agentic Context Management (2026)
edges.note: Where the memory survey treated agent memory as choosing storage and retrieval, this paper reframes it as a lifecycle with explicit decisions about what to keep, how to structure it, and how to compact to a token budget.

edges.target_label: Agentic Context Management (2026)
edges.note: Where the Agent AI survey framed the general agent stack including memory, this paper focuses on managing the reasoning context turn by turn under a token budget and ties each strategy to a cost curve.

edges.target_label: SkillRise: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Cross-Task Skill Evolution (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 improves a policy within a task using outcome rewards, SkillRise adds a second cross-task learning signal that rewards writing down transferable skills, supervised by discounted downstream outcomes.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: SkillRise: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Cross-Task Skill Evolution (2026)
edges.note: Where the memory survey catalogs how agents store and recall information, SkillRise makes the memory itself a learned object shaped by the reward function, so the skill document is trained rather than hand-designed.

edges.target_label: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies (2026)
edges.note: Where the Agent AI survey maps what agents can do, this paper measures whether an agent can drive an open research question end to end, and supplies a boundary result: engineering is handled, research judgment is not.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies (2026)
edges.note: Where the memory survey maps how agents remember and act over long horizons, this paper grades agents on two unpublished NeurIPS 2026 research questions and names five recurring failure modes that block the harder part.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: LycheeMemory V2: Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents via Semantic Segment-Level Consolidation (2026)
edges.note: Where the survey catalogued what an agent should retain and named context explosion as the central gap, this paper isolates when consolidation happens and reports that timing moves the accuracy-cost curve.

edges.target_label: LycheeMemory V2: Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents via Semantic Segment-Level Consolidation (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS spent extra calls at query time to search over context, LycheeMemory pushes the cost to write time and amortizes it over a segment, so query-time token usage stays flat while construction cost drops by three quarters or more.

edges.source_label: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026)
edges.target_label: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence (2026)
edges.note: Where the survey catalogued what is stored, how it is written, and how it is retrieved but left trust unmodelled, SMA attaches a scalar to each lesson and updates it from downstream retrieval outcomes, turning memory quality into an online estimation problem.

edges.target_label: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS consumed reflection inside one episode to guide search and discarded it at the end, SMA writes the product of reflection out as a retrievable artefact that later and different tasks can read.

edges.source_label: PyVision: Agentic Vision with Dynamic Tooling (Zhao 2025)
edges.target_label: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence (2026)
edges.note: PyVision places spatial competence in external tools called at inference; SMA argues the same gain is available from retrieved text alone, pushing the tool-embedding bridge back toward the frozen model's own context.
